nonworking_scope.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) total,SUM(empresa_id=0 AND sucursal_id=0 AND sector_id=0) global_scope,SUM(d.empresa_id<>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM empresas e WHERE e.id=d.empresa_id)) invalid_company,SUM(d.sucursal_id<>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sucursales s WHERE s.id=d.sucursal_id)) invalid_branch,SUM(d.sector_id<>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sectores s WHERE s.id=d.sector_id)) invalid_sector FROM asistencia_dias_no_laborables d

incomplete_by_month.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fecha,'%Y-%m') month,COUNT(*) total,SUM(hora_entrada IS NOT NULL AND hora_salida IS NULL) missing_exit,SUM(hora_entrada IS NULL AND hora_salida IS NOT NULL) missing_entry FROM asistencias WHERE fecha<DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 3 HOUR) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

incomplete_with_marks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) missing_exit,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asistencia_marcas m WHERE m.empleado_id=a.empleado_id AND m.fecha=a.fecha AND m.accion='egreso')) days_with_exit_mark FROM asistencias a WHERE a.fecha<DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 3 HOUR) AND a.hora_entrada IS NOT NULL AND a.hora_salida IS NULL

safety_future.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) future_rows FROM sh_eventos WHERE fecha_evento>DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 3 HOUR)
